o.norm: Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.

i.norm: Asserts that the default (strict) NYSIIS encoder produces {@code expectedEncoding} for every string in {@code inputs}.

Verifies that "Phil" encodes to "FAL" under the strict NYSIIS algorithm. The leading "PH" is transcoded to "FF", yielding first key character 'F'; the vowel 'i' becomes 'A'; and 'l' remains 'L', giving the three-character code "FAL".
